title: The Log Receivers page in the Admin Console

prose.text: The Log Receivers page lists, copies, edits and deletes receivers.

checks.do: Whether the receiver was created by Zscaler Deception when copy, edit and delete are missing.
Which columns to read for a quick check of address, port, TLS and log type.

page-columns.statement: The Log Receivers page shows for each receiver its name, domain name or IP address, TCP port, TLS Encryption status and log type, and the receiver's details add the description, the App Connector groups and the log stream content.

quotes: Domain Name or IP Address: The destination address of the server that collects the logs (e.g., your SIEM collector).
TCP Port: The TCP port that the log receiver is listening on for incoming log streams.
TLS Encryption: The status of whether the log receiver is secured using TLS.
App Connector Groups: The App Connector group that sends the logs to the log receiver.
Log Stream Content: Defines the exact structure and fields included in each log message.

copy-edit-delete.statement: A receiver can be copied to create a new configuration, edited and deleted from the page.

quotes: Copy a log receiver's configuration and use it to create a new configuration.

deception-readonly.statement: If a log receiver is configured using Zscaler Deception, the copy, edit and delete options are unavailable.

quotes: If a log receiver is configured using Zscaler Deception, then the copy, edit, and delete options are unavailable.
